All matter fields Ψ (every species, uniformly) couple minimally only to g~_{μν}; C and D are universal functions of (φ,X) with no per-species or per-object parameters.
canonical.claimed_static_limit: In the weak-field, static, spherically symmetric limit with φ settling to a slowly varying background (X→X0 small), and with f→const≈1, C→1, D→0 at leading order, the action is expected to approach the Schwarzschild/PPN limit up to corrections set by C_φ, C_X, D evaluated at the background. The magnitude and sign of these corrections are not computed here and are not claimed to satisfy any Solar-System bound; that determination belongs to the vacuum/Newtonian-asymptotics and Solar-System-control gates, which have not been run on this candidate.
evasion_rationale: Not a gradient_state construct: X=g^{μν}∂_μφ∂_νφ enters only through the universal functions C(φ,X), D(φ,X) applied identically to the single matter metric shared by all species; it is not used to build a per-object or per-species state-dependent response coefficient.
Not a measured_state construct: g~_{μν} is defined purely covariantly from (g,φ,∂φ) inside the action; no operationally- or measurement-defined variable enters the Lagrangian.
Not a flux construct: the map from (g,φ,∂φ) to g~ is strictly local and pointwise; no surface integral, boundary flux, or non-local flux-through-a-region term is used anywhere.

Not a saturation construct: C and D are left as general functions with no inserted threshold, cutoff, or saturation scale tied to any specific object's properties, consistent with the no-object-specific-parameters requirement.

The higher-derivative terms a1, a2 are restricted by an explicit machine-readable algebraic relation (dc1) rather than a prose-only degeneracy claim, directly targeting the prior higher_derivative_degeneracy_declaration rejections.
canonical.expected_dof: Nominally 3: 2 tensor (graviton) polarizations plus 1 scalar (φ), contingent on dc1 and dc2 holding exactly to remove the Ostrogradski mode from the (φ_{μν}φ^{μν}, (Box φ)²) sector. The full Hamiltonian/constraint analysis including feedback from the disformally coupled matter sector has not been performed by this proposal; additional propagating modes cannot be excluded prior to that gate.

S = S_grav + S_phi + S_m, with

S_grav = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) (M_Pl^2/2) F(phi) R

S_phi = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g) [ P(phi,X) + Q(phi,X) Box(phi) + A1(phi,X) ( phi_{mu nu} phi^{mu nu} - (Box phi)^2 ) ]

S_m = ∫d^4x sqrt(-g_tilde) L_m[ g_tilde_{mu nu}, Psi_m ],
  g_tilde_{mu nu} = Omega(phi,X) g_{mu nu} + Gamma(phi,X) phi_mu phi_nu

where phi_mu = grad_mu phi, X = g^{mu nu} phi_mu phi_nu, phi_{mu nu} = grad_mu grad_nu phi, Box phi = g^{mu nu} phi_{mu nu}. F, P, Q, A1, Omega, Gamma are free functions restricted to the bounded_grammar below (same six functions for every matter species -- no per-species or per-object parameters enter g_tilde). The A2 term of the general class-Ia DHOST Lagrangian is fixed identically to -A1 by construction (folded into the single written combination), and A3=A4=A5=0 by grammar exclusion (not generated by the basis), restricting to the minimal degenerate quadratic subclass.
canonical.claimed_static_limit: In the static, slowly-varying regime (X -> 0, phi ~ const to leading order) with F,Omega -> 1 + O(phi/M, X/M^4) and Gamma -> O(1/M^4), the action formally reduces to General Relativity plus a canonically normalized scalar with weak-field PPN-type parameters expressible as Taylor coefficients of F, Omega, Gamma at X=0. No specific numerical PPN bound, Newtonian-limit fit, or agreement with any measurement is claimed; whether this limit is phenomenologically viable is unknown pending the vacuum/Newtonian asymptotics and Solar-System control gates.
evasion_rationale: Repeated rejections clustered at universal_minimal_matter_coupling across gradient_state, measured_state, flux, and saturation mechanism tags suggest prior candidates used per-object or per-species coupling functions; this proposal instead builds a single disformal metric g_tilde from only two universal functions of (phi,X), applied identically to all matter, to directly target that gate.

The gradient_state, flux, and saturation mechanism tags are folded into a single grammar: X = g^{mu nu} phi_mu phi_nu covers gradient_state and the flux-like current phi^mu, while a bounded saturating basis element (tanh(X/M^4)) covers the saturation tag; measured_state is covered by bare phi-dependence, so one construction spans all four previously-failing mechanism tags rather than proposing four separate ad hoc couplings.

Repeated rejections at higher_derivative_degeneracy_declaration indicate prior higher-derivative candidates lacked explicit machine-readable degeneracy relations; here the only second-derivative-of-phi term is written in the fixed combination A1(phi_{mu nu}phi^{mu nu} - (Box phi)^2), with the underlying A2=-A1 relation and the A3=A4=A5=0 grammar exclusions stated as explicit equalities rather than prose.

None of this constitutes proof that the gates will be passed; the degeneracy conditions and dof count are declared and unverified, and must still be checked against the pipeline's own Hamiltonian, hyperbolicity, and covariance-identity analyses.
canonical.expected_dof: Under the five declared degeneracy conditions (all currently "declared_unverified"), the naive expectation is 2 tensor + 1 scalar = 3 propagating degrees of freedom, matching the class-Ia DHOST/beyond-Horndeski counting for this restricted (F_X=0, A3=A4=A5=0) subclass. This count is a structural expectation from the literature pattern being mimicked, not a result of an independent Hamiltonian/constraint analysis performed here; the kinetic-rank and constraint-counting gate is expected to either confirm or falsify it.

canonical.matter_metric: gtilde_munu = Omega2(phi) g_munu, a single universal conformal factor applied identically to every matter field; no disformal term, no per-species or per-object parameter of any kind (satisfies one_universal_matter_metric and no_object_specific_parameters by construction).
canonical.proposal_type: scalar-tensor covariant gravity action: degenerate quadratic Horndeski subclass (bounded polynomial grammar) with universal conformal matter coupling
symmetries: local Lorentz invariance of the matter sector via vierbein formulation
no shift symmetry assumed for phi (Omega2(phi) and V(phi) may break it explicitly)
universal_constants: Newton_constant_GN (fixed by Mpl and the background value G4(phi0,X0))

leading_work_candidates.expression:
S = Integral d^4x sqrt(-g) [ (Mpl^2/2) R + G2(phi,X) + G3(phi,X) BoxPhi + G4(phi,X) R + G4_X(phi,X) ( (BoxPhi)^2 - phi_munu phi^munu ) ] + S_m[ gtilde_munu, Psi_i ]

where X = -(1/2) g^munu d_mu(phi) d_nu(phi), BoxPhi = g^munu D_mu D_nu phi, phi_munu = D_mu D_nu phi, G4_X = dG4/dX, and S_m couples every Standard Model matter multiplet Psi_i identically and only to the single effective metric gtilde_munu = Omega2(phi) g_munu, with Omega2(phi) = 1 + xi*phi/Mpl (no disformal d_phi d_phi term added to gtilde, no per-species or per-object factor of any kind). G2, G3, and G4 are each restricted to a finite polynomial drawn from the bounded grammar below (basis {1, phi, phi^2, X, phi*X, X^2}, with G4's R-multiplying piece built from the same basis); i.e. this proposal is a finite, enumerable family of theories, not an arbitrary-free-function class.

why_prioritized.semantics: work ordering within declared grammar; not probability of truth
